```{r}
## package installation
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("googlesheets4")
install.packages("ggplot2")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#importing the datasheet from google sheets
hplc <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1UmKBgSnG77ulOw50kXFPXRezxwY9M1guPTkz2kQOfiI/edit?gid=0#gid=0")
```

```{r}
#practice visualizations 

hplc_clean <- hplc %>%
filter(!is.na(adjConcentration)) %>%
filter(compound %in% c("MHET", "TPA"))

sample_names <- c(
  "3" = "E. Coli",
  "4" = "New Soil",
  "5" = "Old Soil",
  "6" = "PBS Buffer Control")

sample_colors <- c(
  "3" = "darkolivegreen3",
  "4" = "goldenrod1",
  "5" = "lightblue",
  "6" = "tomato")

#####MHET plot
ggplot(data = hplc_clean %>% filter(compound == "MHET"),
       aes(x = dayNumber, y = adjConcentration,
           color = factor(sampleNumber),
           group = sampleNumber)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = sample_colors,
    labels = sample_names,
    name = "Sample") +
  labs(title = "MHET Concentration Over Time",
    x = "Day",
    y = "MHET Concentration") +
 theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

######both 
ggplot(data = hplc_clean,
       aes(x = dayNumber, y = adjConcentration,
           color = factor(sampleNumber),
           group = sampleNumber)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~compound, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors,
    labels = sample_names,
    name = "Sample") +
  labs(title = "HPLC Compound Concentrations Over Time",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Concentration") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
```
